verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents real-time webhooks with delivery-status inspection, re-delivery, and stable event IDs. It also has a subscriptions/invoicing billing suite and agent access to the account through the AgentOS MCP server and CLI. Together these give an agent a documented way to watch account events, but nothing ties them to failed-payment events or dunning specifically. Missing for 10: documented failed-payment webhook events, an automatic or API-driven payment retry capability, dunning or reminder outreach for unpaid invoices or subscriptions, and any agent skill or hands-on evidence of this workflow.
